notes.empty_kg: the empty tank, 360 lb (f16net-300); the centreline pylon it hangs on is the jet's (the model's own, always fitted). FlightGear's F-16 gives the tank with its pylon 462 lb (fg-f16-pylons)
notes.name: the fuel it holds in pounds, as the 370's and the 600's: a name with LB is a tank (stores.rs is_tank)
notes.kg: the fuel of a full tank: 300 US gal (f16net-300; 1135.6 l) of JP-8 at 0.80 kg/l (inferred density, as the 370's and the 600's), 908 kg (2002 lb); the tank's own 360 lb (163 kg) is its empty_kg
notes.drag: carriage drag index (10^4 x the drag coefficient on the F-16's 300 sq ft wing, flight-model.md §9.18): 0.15 x its frontal area, an ellipse 0.918 m wide and 0.594 m high (0.428 m², fg-300g): 23.05, 0.15 the drag of a streamlined tank on its pylon on that area (inferred, as the 370's and the 600's); the F-16 manual's published indices were not at hand
notes.motion: the reader's defaults (a jettisoned tank falls ballistic)
notes.model: our 300 US gal tank (shared/extra/models/stores/f16ftk300.glb: FlightGear's 300G.ac at its own size, painted grey as the 370 and the 600), hung under the model's centreline pylon (sim.rs F16_SIM_LUGS StationK; stores.gd LUGGED)
notes.size: 4.515 m long, 0.918 m wide, 0.594 m high: FlightGear's model, kept (fg-300g). F-16.net's report gives the tank as "about 12 feet long and 2½ feet wide" (3.66 m by 0.76 m; f16net-300); a tank that size in this flattened shape holds about 200 US gal, too little for 300, so the rounded figures are not used (inferred). FlightGear's shape holds about 370 US gal outside (its cross-sections summed), room for 300 inside its walls (inferred); on commons-857 its height is about 0.7 of the 600's 0.828 m and its nose about 1.2 m aft of the nose wheel, as here (0.594 m; 1.26 m; inferred). No published size was found (open)
notes.fit: on the centreline (the real 5, the record's 11; f16i.glb, gear down): from 1.70 m ahead of the pylon's middle to 2.82 m behind it, its top on the centreline pylon's bottom, its bottom 0.086 m above the wheels' bottom (commons-857 shows the real tank close to the ground too), 0.20 m from the main gear's legs, 0.16 m from the Litening on 5R, 0.23 m from the navigation pod on 5L, 0.64 m from the 600s on 4 / 6, its nose 1.26 m aft of the nose wheel's axle (0.66 m aft of the nose gear's rearmost part)
notes.generation: ours: the weapons.ibx section key (generation · 1000 + type) is one per weapon of a kind
